info.description: Horizontal product scroll carousel with title, badge, CTA, and custom card styles.

adminDisplayTitle.description: Internal name to identify this scroll section in Strapi admin lists.

title.description: Main title heading of the product scroll section.

badge.description: Top badge or category tag displayed above the section title (e.g. 'BEST SELLERS').

description.description: Short subtitle or description below the section header.

headerStyle.description: Header title and badge typography style (e.g. style-1, style-2).

cardStyle.description: Visual style for individual product cards (e.g. card-1, card-2, card-3).

buttonText.description: Optional CTA button label (e.g. 'View All Products').

buttonLink.description: Destination URL for the CTA button (e.g. '/store' or '/collections/best-sellers').

products.description: Select specific Medusa products to display in the horizontal carousel.

image.description: Optional side or promotional banner image for split scroll styles.
